name: ✨ llm_augment · ticket triage
description: Real customer-support tickets, free text. The flow uses the configured LLM to (1) classify each ticket as bug / billing / feature_request / general_question, (2) extract structured fields (sentiment, urgency, blocker_yes_no), and (3) generate a one-line summary suitable for a triage table.

params.labels: bug, billing, feature_request, general_question, churn_risk, praise
params.context: Classify the support-ticket body into the most fitting category from the labels list.

From the support-ticket body, extract: sentiment (positive/neutral/negative), urgency (low/medium/high), blocker_yes_no (yes if the user can't proceed at all), mentioned_competitor (the competitor's name if any, else null).
